sections.heading: Your right to change your mind
sections.text: If you ordered online or by phone, you have fourteen days to change your mind and cancel without giving a reason. For services, the fourteen days start on the day you placed the order; for devices such as phones, they start on the day the device is delivered. Cancelling within this period ends the contract with no early exit fee. Orders placed in a shop follow the shop's own returns policy, which is printed on your receipt.
questions: Can I cancel my new contract if I've changed my mind?
When does the fourteen-day cooling-off period start?

sections.heading: How to cancel
sections.text: Cancel by calling us, through the chat in the app, or by sending the cancellation form included with your order confirmation. Tell us which services or devices you want to cancel, since you can keep some and cancel others. We confirm the cancellation by email within one working day, together with returns instructions for any equipment and devices. Make sure you keep the confirmation email until everything is settled.
questions: How do I cancel a Meridian order within fourteen days?
Can I cancel part of my order and keep the rest?

sections.heading: Paying for what you used
sections.text: If you started using a service during the cooling-off period, you pay only for the days you used it, worked out from the monthly price. Calls, data and other extras used during that time are charged as normal. Any money paid in advance beyond that is refunded within fourteen days of the cancellation. If you had a number transferred to us and cancel, ask your new provider to collect it before the service ends.
questions: Do I pay anything if I cancel during the cooling-off period?
How quickly will I get a refund after cancelling?

sections.heading: Returning a device
sections.text: A phone or tablet returned during the cooling-off period must be in the condition it arrived, with its box and accessories, and with any accounts removed and the device reset. We send a prepaid returns bag for it. If a device is returned damaged or with clear signs of heavy use, we may reduce the refund to reflect its lower value. A device with a fault is handled under its warranty instead.
questions: How do I return a phone I don't want?
Will I get a full refund if I've used the phone I'm returning?

title: Leaving at the end of your contract

sections.heading: When your minimum term ends
sections.text: Between ten and forty days before your minimum term ends, we tell you the end date, your current price, the price you will pay afterwards and the best plans available to you. After the end date, your service continues month to month at the standard price unless you choose otherwise. You can leave at any point after that with thirty days' notice and without an exit fee. The end date is also shown in your online account.
questions: When does my Meridian contract end?
What happens when my minimum term is up?

sections.heading: Giving notice
sections.text: To leave home internet or TV, give thirty days' notice by calling us or using the chat. If you are moving to another provider for home internet on the same type of line, your new provider can usually arrange the switch for you, and the notice period is handled automatically. To leave with your mobile number, request a switching code instead, and the account closes when the number moves.
questions: How much notice do I need to give to leave Meridian?
Does my new broadband provider cancel Meridian for me?

sections.heading: Your final bill
sections.text: Your final bill covers charges up to the end of your notice period, minus anything paid in advance beyond it. It also includes any outstanding usage and charges for unreturned equipment. It is produced within thirty days of your service ending and collected by your usual payment method. If you are owed money, it is refunded automatically. Keep the final bill, because it confirms the account was closed.
questions: What will be on my final Meridian bill?
How will I get money back if I'm owed a refund after leaving?

sections.heading: Before you go
sections.text: Check whether a different plan would suit you better, because customers coming to the end of a contract can often get a lower price by re-contracting. If you are leaving because of a problem, tell us, and we will try to put it right. Save anything you need from your Meridian email account, and arrange to keep the address if you would like to. Return all loaned equipment within thirty days.
questions: Can I get a better deal if I stay at the end of my contract?
What should I sort out before leaving Meridian?

sections.heading: How the fee is worked out
sections.text: If you leave before your minimum term ends, an early exit fee normally applies. It is the total of the monthly charges left in your minimum term, reduced to take account of the costs we no longer have to pay, such as network charges for the line. The exact amount is shown in your online account under Contracts and is updated every month, so you can see what leaving would cost on any date.
questions: How much will it cost to leave my contract early?
Where can I see my early exit fee?

sections.heading: When no fee applies
sections.text: You can leave without an exit fee within the fourteen-day cooling-off period, if we cannot fix a fault on our side within the time set in our service promise, if your speed stays below your guaranteed minimum after thirty days of trying to fix it, or if we make a change to your contract that is to your disadvantage. Moving to an address we cannot serve also ends home internet without a fee.
questions: When can I cancel early without paying a fee?
Can I leave if my broadband speed is always below the guarantee?

sections.heading: Handset agreements
sections.text: A handset agreement is separate from your airtime plan. Leaving the plan early does not cancel the agreement: you keep paying the monthly handset amount until the phone is paid off, or you can pay the remaining balance in one go at any time without a penalty. The remaining balance is shown in the app under My devices. Paying off a handset early never changes your airtime plan.
questions: Do I still pay for my phone if I cancel my mobile plan?
Can I pay off my handset early?

sections.heading: Difficult circumstances
sections.text: We may waive or reduce an exit fee in difficult circumstances, such as serious illness, moving into residential care, being posted abroad with the armed forces, or the death of the account holder. Contact our support team and explain the situation; we may ask for supporting documents, which we handle in confidence. Each case is looked at individually, and we aim to reply within five working days.
questions: Can the exit fee be waived if I'm moving into a care home?
I'm being posted overseas. Do I have to pay to leave my contract?

title: Closing an account after a bereavement

sections.heading: Telling us about a death
sections.text: We are sorry for your loss. You can tell us that an account holder has died through the bereavement form on our website, by phone on our dedicated bereavement line, or in any Meridian shop. You will need the account holder's name and address and, ideally, the account number. We ask for a copy of the death certificate or a similar document, but you can start the process before you have it.
questions: How do I tell Meridian that my father has died?
What do I need to close the account of someone who has died?

sections.heading: Closing or transferring services
sections.text: You can close the account or transfer the services to someone else, such as a partner who lives at the same address. Transfers keep the phone numbers, home internet and email address in place, with no break in service and no new credit check for a spouse or partner. When an account is closed after a death, no early exit fee is charged and any outstanding handset balance is reviewed.
questions: Can I take over my late husband's Meridian account?
Is there a cancellation fee when closing a deceased person's account?

sections.heading: Keeping a phone number or messages
sections.text: Families often wish to keep a loved one's mobile number for a while, so that voicemails and texts are not lost. We can keep the number active on a free low-use plan for up to twelve months, or transfer it to a family member. Voicemail greetings and messages can be saved as audio files before an account closes. Tell us early if this matters to you, because closed numbers are released after a set period.
questions: Can we keep my mum's phone number so we don't lose her voicemails?
How do I save voicemail messages from a relative who has passed away?

sections.heading: The final bill
sections.text: Charges stop from the date of death once we have been notified, and anything paid beyond that date is refunded to the estate. The final bill is sent to the person dealing with the estate, not to the deceased person's address, unless you ask otherwise. Any balance owed is treated as a debt of the estate, and we do not chase family members personally for it. Direct debits are cancelled automatically.
questions: Who receives the final bill after someone dies?
Will family members have to pay a deceased person's phone bill?
